abstract_graph_control.name: K5 split into K2 and K3

named_six_incidence_control.name: six_incidence_two_by_three_forbidden_rectangle
named_six_incidence_control.scope: One named t=6 sharp-boundary control only; no classification of all six-incidence pairs or planar six-cuts.

positional_negative_control.assertion: L/R type membership alone is not sufficient; the same four positions are required.

proof.at_most_five_cells: A Hall failure with 2 or 3 rows needs at least 6 forbidden cells. With at most 5, failure is exactly a full forbidden row or column.
proof.forbidden_cell: (a,b) forbids pi(b)=a; at most t distinct forbidden cells.
proof.four_position_form: A full forbidden row/column is equivalent to four incidence positions that are constant on one side and use all four colours on the other.

scope: Complete enumeration for two actual ordered side-incidence colour tuples, one common S4 permutation of the entire second side, and at most five cut incidences. One named t=6 control is separately marked; there is no t=6 classification. No side realizability oracle, marginal splicing, list/fixed-domain permutation permission, larger-cut theorem, planar 4CT, or 932 exclusion claim.
